author: nero_eth
content: Having it priced 100 gas cheaper than cold access makes sense. If you add the data cost, which not only applies to the floor but always, ALs are already economically irrational to use. This was a goal of 7981, even though it meant moving away from the "keep things as-is and count data cost only to floor" priciple (e.g. 8131).

author: nero_eth
content: This is also the number we may want to then use in 7928 for the anti-dos heuristic.
